title: Concept: Workspace dependency resolved from a local path
description: Cargo.toml declares a `path` key inside a `[workspace.dependencies]` entry, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `path` key inside a `[workspace.dependencies]` entry.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `path` key inside a `[workspace.dependencies]` entry.
